question: Can a generated bounded representation/discovery policy improve held-out double-intervention mean prediction over qualified additive, matching-mean and development-tuned ridge workflows using identical observed single-intervention inputs?
primary_endpoint: For each protected pair, RMSE across the unchanged1000 gene-mean panel. For every preregistered qualified control, compute median over44 pairs of1-candidate_RMSE/control_RMSE. Zero-control-loss cases require zero candidate loss and contribute zero gain, otherwise negative infinity.
controls: Systema MatchingMean for two observed single perturbations: predictedAB=(A+B)/2, exact primaryMethods equation at doi10.1038/s41587-025-02777-8. No unseen-singlefallback admitted; all pairconstituents have observed singleinputs.

Full multioutput kernelridge on the symmetric single-effect vector SUM(A-control,B-control), including all1000gene features;80x80Gram. Hyperparameters selected on60fit/20calibration and frozen, then refit on80development. A coordinatewise ridge alone does not qualify this control.

Additive plus per-gene mean developmentresidual: (A+B-ctrl)+meanDEV[AB-(A+B-ctrl)]. Same developmentoutcomes and no extra targetinformation; mandatory intercept-only conventionalcontrol before any representation/policy advantage claim.
control_rule: Implementations, budgets and selected development hyperparameters must be frozen before protected evaluation. Any missing qualified named control prevents claiming this primary advantage. Report all arms, including the best conventional acceptance and costs; no outcome-selected weak comparator.
secondary_endpoint: Within-pair ranking of observed absoluteAB-(A+B-control) mean deviations. NDCG@50 for top100 observed deviations, with preregistered hash tie-breaking; zero-deviation pairs are undefined. This is not biological interaction significance, cellular false-positive rate, clinical usefulness or identifiability.

secondary_definition.true_relevance: Top100 observed absolute deviations per pair

fairness: Same admitted data, information and primary objective; search, failed branches, acquisition, checking and adaptation resources charged. Inherited tool benefit is distinct from policy improvement. Supplied algebra/arithmetic/ridge primitives remain developer-authored; generated compositions do not become unrestricted invention.
confirmation_control: Verifier controls protectedAB; builder cannot inspect outcomes or change verifier. Candidate, comparator, source/task identities, protocol and verifier freeze required before one final fixed44-pair evaluation. If results are used for repair, cases become exposed and cannot retain confirmation status.
uncertainty: Report paired per-pair effects and descriptive sensitivity summaries. No gene-independent standard errors; sharedsingles/control/genes/published preprocessing/model/library/host dependencies disclosed. No biological-population or clinical inference.

campaign_error_budget.interpretation: Fixed-cohort descriptive engineering/scientific pilot threshold only. No resetting previous exposure/error budget.

claim_limits: One published summary-mean panel, not rawcells/variance or new wetlab observations
No globally strongest-method claim without qualifying available alternatives such asGEARS/Systema; unavailable controls remain limitations
Prediction improvement alone does not establish a previously inaccessible productive possibility
No commercial admission, earned funds or positive completecost economics from this pilot
stop_rule: One frozen protected panel, no favorable-result stopping. Preserve ties, losses and unsupported outcomes. Four bounded scientific development attempts maximum within parent allocation; no silent replenishment.
control_qualification: All four complete control implementations, development-selected hyperparameters and information/resource budgets require source-pinned execution before protected comparison. Low-ranklinear/GEARS/Systema comparisons not executed remain explicitlimitations.

functional_acceptance.scope: Swapping A/B labels preserves the same requested unordered simultaneous pair. Functional criterion is frozen before protected prediction outcomes; original development defect/adjudication retained separately.

uncertainty_method: Report pair-effect vectors, theirquantiles, leave-one-pair-out median-gainrange and leave-one-constituent-gene-out median-gainrange when at least10pairsremain. These are fixedcohortdependence sensitivities, notconfidenceintervals or biological sampling claims.
